column1: # Blasphemous (Switch, update 1.0.8 = v524288). Opening gameplay tested on the Mac.
# Unity 2017.4.28f1 IL2CPP, FMOD, SDK 8.3.1, NVN. subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie.
# No NPDM system resource: Unity allocates from a heap of pool minus used memory.
# 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias + 256 MB stack + 3.25 GB heap.
# The rewritten modules exceed the default 64 MB; the packing script computes 112 MB.
# The game sets near=0 at startup; offline pipeline bases must use that depth variant.
